name: glitchr/omnilex
description: Omnilex: one contract for the sources of law - texts, codes and case law, searched with filters (jurisdiction, date, subject, type), read in the version in force at a date, their links followed, what is new listed - from Légifrance, Judilibre, EUR-Lex and the French administrative courts' open data; identifiers (ECLI, NOR, CELEX, pourvoi, Légifrance) normalised and validated; and its Symfony bundle.

suggest.omnilex/legifrance: Légifrance (PISTE): codes, laws, decrees, the Journal officiel, as in force at a date
suggest.omnilex/judilibre: Judilibre (PISTE): the decisions of the Cour de cassation and of the judicial courts
suggest.omnilex/eurlex: EUR-Lex: EU law and the case law of the Court of Justice, from the Publications Office's open endpoint
suggest.omnilex/justice-administrative: The open data of the Conseil d'État, the administrative courts of appeal and the administrative tribunals
suggest.symfony/cache: In a Symfony application: the pool (cache.app) where Omnilex\Bridge\Symfony\CacheTokenStore keeps the PISTE tokens
suggest.symfony/config: In a Symfony application: the configuration of Omnilex\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilexBundle
suggest.symfony/dependency-injection: In a Symfony application: the services of Omnilex\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilexBundle
suggest.symfony/http-kernel: In a Symfony application: Omnilex\Bridge\Symfony\OmnilexBundle itself
